name: stdb-es
description: Add event sourcing to your TypeScript SpacetimeDB app with append-only streams, safe retries, replayable state, and live read models.
author: gervel@jscraftsman.com

scripts.example:build: npm run build && npm run example:typecheck && spacetime build -p examples/counter/spacetimedb
scripts.example:publish: npm run build && npm run example:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter -s local -p examples/counter/spacetimedb
scripts.example:publish:fresh: npm run build && npm run example:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter -s local -p examples/counter/spacetimedb --delete-data=always -y
scripts.example:set:counter:test: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/sets/counter-with-frontend/spacetimedb run test && npm --prefix examples/sets/counter-with-frontend/web run test
scripts.example:set:counter:publish-clean: npm run example:set:counter:build && npm run example:set:counter:generate && npm run example:set:counter:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter-with-frontend -s local -p examples/sets/counter-with-frontend/spacetimedb --delete-data=always -y
scripts.example:set:counter:publish: npm run example:set:counter:build && npm run example:set:counter:generate && npm run example:set:counter:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter-with-frontend -s local -p examples/sets/counter-with-frontend/spacetimedb
scripts.example:set:counter:start: npm run example:set:counter:publish && npm --prefix examples/sets/counter-with-frontend/web run dev
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:pack
